notes.title: New Version Driver Booster 3.3 Has Being Updated With New Features!
notes.notes:
Thanks for all of you guys' support. And we are keeping working on the Driver Booster and offering you the best softeware. Check the new version with the new features below:

+ Optimized online database for better device-driver match and faster scan 
+ Optimized Toolkit to fix more device problems
+ Supported Oculus VR drivers updates to bring the cutting-edge technology
+ Added driver updates for Intel 6th Generation CPU and Iris Pro and HD Graphics, AMD Radeon Crimson, Nvidia, etc.
+ Fixed bugs

notes.title: Here Comes With the New Version Driver Booster 3.2 For 2016!
notes.notes:
We are glad to let you know that we are bringing the new Driver Booster 3.2 for you guys. Enjoy the New Year 2016! Enjoy our New Driver Booster!

New Features as below:

+ Added a new tool to fix various device errors and integrated all the 5 tools into Toolkit
+ Optimized a lot features for better user experience
+ Optimized the driver download engine for higher download success ratio
+ Optimized the driver installation engine for smarter and safer installation
+ Added driver updates for Realtek Audio ALC8xx, ALC9xx, ALC2xx and Intel, AMD, Nvidia graphics to improve audio & video performance
+ Added more Windows 10 driver updates including Graphics, Net, Audio, etc. 
+ Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Here Comes With the New Version Driver Booster 3.1
notes.notes:
Good to let you guys know that we have updated the Driver Booster. Check out the new features that Driver Booster 3.1 comes with:

+ Fixed most scan failures with the scan engine optimized
+ Added 4 tools to fix common problems like no sound, network failure, etc
+ Improved driver update process to smartly adjust display, audio, and more settings
+ Better support for high resolution screens including 2K, 3K, and 4K
+ Added support for touchscreen to use more easily 
+ Added localization for Arabic, Persian, and Ukrainian
+ Fixed minor bugs
